name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor, the collaboration layer, the phone layout kit and the update client. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo.

platforms_note: A SHIPPING RECORD, as Void Maiz and Void Hormiga use the field: both were built and handed to a person (0.2.0, 2026-09-21; the author ran the APK on a phone). The Windows build is a portable .zip and the Android build an .apk, not the setup.exe / .tar.gz that `mago feed` names today, so tools/package_release.ps1 fills in the artifact names and hashes after Mago writes the document (asked of Void Mago 2026-09-21).

release.summary: the phone layout fits the screen and turns with it, and the app can update itself
adds: On a phone: every action fits the screen, and what does not fit waits behind a '...' button instead of falling off the edge
Turn the phone sideways and the inspector moves beside the canvas; upright, it lives in a sheet you drag up from the bottom
On a phone the whole net is framed when it first appears, and again every time you rotate
Updates: the app asks once whether to check for new versions when it starts, shows what a new version changes, and installs it only when you choose to
View > Check for updates, and an Updates section in Settings

behavior_changes.what: On a phone, the menus moved behind the '...' button at the top right, and the log pane is gone (errors still appear as messages)
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone used to the 0.2.0 phone layout

behavior_changes.what: On a phone, the camera is reset to frame the whole net when the app opens and whenever the phone is rotated
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: phone users who expect the view to stay where they left it
